title: Demo example --- Chicken thighs with rice and broccoli
recipe:
Season the chicken with paprika and salt. Fry skin-side down in olive oil for 8 minutes, flip, and cook 10 more minutes.
Cook the rice. Steam the broccoli for 4 minutes and toss with garlic.
Serve everything together with a squeeze of lemon.
notes: Very good. Next time add a bit more lemon.
